facts: Parties: Holloway Bioscience plc (Buyer), Corrib Retail Group plc (Seller); the Company is Kingsmere Robotics Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 19 April 2027; Closing is scheduled for 4 July 2027 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 30 days of becoming aware of it.

Section 9.4 (De Minimis and Basket): the Seller shall not be liable unless the aggregate of all claims exceeds $675,000 (0.5% of the Purchase Price), in which case the Seller shall be liable only for the excess over that amount.
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 2 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $6,500,000, capped at $3,000,000.

Section 9.2 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 25% of the Purchase Price, being $27,000,000. The Purchase Price is $135,000,000 (see Section 2.1).
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 45 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.
Item 5: the board noted a letter before action from Foxley Energy plc threatening proceedings for approximately $3,400,000 in respect of alleged defective deliveries. Management to monitor.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $8,600,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $2,600,000.
